newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse changes trading hours for Ramadan.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse changes trading hours for Ramadan.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange has changed its trading hours for the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
The 2-1/2 hour trading sessions start at 11 a.m. (0800 GMT) from Saturday. The starting time will revert to 10 a.m. (0700 GMT) after Ramadan.
The bourse's index ended the five-day trading week on Wednesday at 1,889.8 points, down 15.8.
